system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

When initiative is rolled, your Nin-Dog uses the advanced transformation technique, transforming to look exactly like you, with notable differences. While transformed, creatures cannot discern between either of you without Chakra Sight and your Nin-Dog gains the benefit of your Four-Legs Taijutsu stance and can become Feral when you do.
